values: 持续消耗自身生命值，朝敌方阵营发射火焰。
Talene consumes her HP to shoot flames at enemies.

选择战场中轴线上的一个格子，塔琳会飞到该位置，随后向敌方阵营方向发射5格长度的火焰冲击，期间每秒消耗12.5%最大生命值和250点能量，对范围内敌人造成150% + 20% ATK伤害，并附带自身生命流失量170% + 5%的额外伤害，该额外伤害由命中的所有敌人分摊。
能量耗尽时，塔琳会继续释放该技能，但每秒消耗的生命值提高至20%。该技能在范围内无敌人时立即结束。

Talene flies to a designated tile in the center of the battlefield, consumes 12.5% of her max HP and 250 Energy per second to shoot a 5-tile flame, dealing 150% + 20% ATK damage and extra damage equal to 170% + 5% of her lost HP to enemies within range. The extra damage is shared among all hit enemies.
Talene can cast this skill even when she is out of Energy, but the HP consumed per second will increase to 20%. This skill ends when there are no enemies within range.
每秒对敌人的伤害提高至160% + 20% ATK，附带的额外伤害提高至生命流失量的190% + 5%。
Increases damage dealt per second to 160% + 20% ATK and extra damage to 190% + 5% of her lost HP.
每秒对敌人的伤害提高至170% + 20% ATK，附带的额外伤害提高至生命流失量的210% + 5%。
Increases damage dealt per second to 170% + 20% ATK and extra damage to 210% + 5% of her lost HP.
每秒对敌人的伤害提高至180% + 20% ATK，附带的额外伤害提高至生命流失量的230% + 5%。
Increases damage dealt per second to 180% + 20% ATK and extra damage to 230% + 5% of her lost HP.
每秒对敌人的伤害提高至190% + 20% ATK，附带的额外伤害提高至生命流失量的250% + 5%。
Increases damage dealt per second to 190% + 20% ATK and extra damage to 250% + 5% of her lost HP.
被动地，自身损失生命值时可为队友回复生命值；自身获得治疗时对敌人造成伤害。主动使用时，召唤天火对敌方造成伤害。

Passive. Talene restores HP for allies when she loses HP and deals damage to enemies when she is healed. 
Active. Talene summons Divine Fire to deal damage to enemies.

被动地，每当自身损失10%最大生命值，便会产生一道暖流，使最虚弱的其他友方英雄回复40% ATK生命值；每当自身回复10%最大生命值，便会产生一道激流，对最健康的敌人造成50% ATK伤害。
主动使用时，消耗20%最大生命值，在敌方最密集区域召唤天火，对半径1格范围内造成200% + 10% ATK伤害，该伤害获得额外40 + 3点生命汲取。

Passive. Whenever Talene loses 10% of her max HP, she will release a warm current that restores 40% ATK HP for the weakest allied hero. Whenever she restores 10% of her max HP, she will unleash a torrent that deals 50% ATK damage to the healthiest enemy.
Active. Talene consumes 20% of her max HP to summon Divine Fire in the area with the most enemies, dealing 200% + 10% ATK damage that comes with an extra 40 + 3 Life Drain to adjacent enemies.
主动使用时，对敌人的伤害提升至215% + 10% ATK。
主动使用时，对敌人的伤害提升至230% + 10% ATK。
主动使用时，对敌人的伤害提升至240% + 10% ATK。
每次被击败后化作一团火焰，期间缓缓回复生命值，生命值回复至一定值后可重生。
Talene transforms into a ball of flame whenever she is defeated, during which her HP will restore over time. She can resurrect when her HP reaches a certain value.
塔琳每次被击败后化作一团火焰，火焰状态下不算作存活英雄，不会被敌人攻击，每秒恢复最大生命值的8%，且可以受到友军技能的影响。当自身生命值恢复到65%以上时将会重生，同时产生一次火焰爆炸，对2格内敌人造成150% + 10% ATK伤害并将其击退1格。塔琳每次重生，将会使自身在后续的火焰状态下永久降低33点受愈。

Talene transforms into a ball of flame whenever she is defeated. During this state, she cannot be attacked as she is not considered alive, and she can restore 8% of her max HP per second as well as benefit from allies' skills. When her HP reaches above 65%, she will resurrect and bring about an explosion, dealing 150% + 10% ATK damage to enemies within 2 tiles and knocking them 1 tile back. After each resurrection, her Vitality during the flame state will be reduced permanently by 33.
后续每次重生所降低的受愈减少至32点。
After each resurrection, Talene's Vitality will be reduced by 32.
后续每次重生所降低的受愈减少至31点。
After each resurrection, Talene's Vitality will be reduced by 31.
后续每次重生所降低的受愈减少至30点。
After each resurrection, Talene's Vitality will be reduced by 30.
消耗一定生命值可提高攻击力。
Talene increases her ATK after she has consumed a certain amount of HP.
每当自身消耗50%最大生命值，提升8%攻击力，最多提升32%。
Talene increases her ATK by 8% for up to 32% whenever she has consumed 50% of her max HP.
每当自身消耗50%最大生命值，提升9%攻击力，最多提升36%。
Talene increases her ATK by 9% for up to 36% whenever she has consumed 50% of her max HP.
每当自身消耗50%最大生命值，提升10%攻击力，最多提升40%。
Talene increases her ATK by 10% for up to 40% whenever she has consumed 50% of her max HP.
强化布阵最靠前的友方英雄，使其持续对周围敌人造成伤害。
Talene enhances the frontmost allied hero, allowing them to deal continuous damage to adjacent enemies.
战斗开始时，为除自己外布阵最靠前的友方英雄赋予“不灭凤焰”，持续至战斗结束。“不灭凤焰”的携带者每秒会对相邻的敌人造成自身攻击力50%的伤害，并为自身恢复伤害量25%的生命。每当受“不灭凤焰”的携带者累计获得相当于自身攻击力500%的治疗时，便会在身旁产生一枚火种并将其吸收，并永久强化“不灭凤焰”，使该技能造成的伤害提高50%，最多叠加3次。

Talene grants Pyre of Renewal to the frontmost allied hero other than herself from the beginning of the battle until the end. Pyre of Renewal carrier will deal damage equal to 50% of their ATK per second to adjacent enemies and restore HP equal to 25% of their damage dealt. Every time the carrier is healed by an amount equal to 500% of their ATK, a kindling will be generated next to them to permanently enhance Talene's Pyre of Renewal, increasing its damage dealt by 50% for up to 3 stacks.
“不灭凤焰”对附近敌人伤害提升至自身攻击力的55%，生命恢复提升至伤害量的30%。
Increases Pyre of Renewal carrier's damage dealt to adjacent enemies to 55% of their ATK, and HP recovery to 30% of their damage dealt.
“不灭凤焰”对附近敌人伤害提升至自身攻击力的60%，生命恢复提升至伤害量的35%。
Increases Pyre of Renewal carrier's damage dealt to adjacent enemies to 60% of their ATK, and HP recovery to 35% of their damage dealt.
当“不灭凤焰”强化至最高层数后，当其携带者被击败时，将消耗全部“不灭凤焰”，使携带者化为一团火焰，并在3秒后以50%最大生命值重生。本效果每场战斗只能生效一次。

When Pyre of Renewal reaches the maximum number of stacks and its carrier is defeated, all stacks will be consumed to transform the carrier into a ball of flame. The carrier will then resurrect in 3s with 50% of their max HP. This effect can only be triggered once in each battle.
首次被击败时，生命恢复的速度提升。
Talene increases her HP recovery rate when defeated for the first time.
每次战斗首次被击败时，自身在火焰状态下生命恢复速度提高至每秒15%点生命值。
Talene increases her HP recovered per second to 15% while in the flame state when defeated for the first time in a battle.
